svg.title: Private 5G surveillance — end-to-end data plane flow
svg.desc: Linear pipeline: SCB800 camera streams H.264 RTSP over 5G NR Uu to gNodeB, forwarded via N3 GTP-U tunnel to Celona UPF, decapsulated and sent over N6 as RTSP/TCP to MediaMTX, which transcodes to WebRTC and delivers via WHEP to the React dashboard.
svg.text: End-to-end video data plane · left to right
